title: Market Research manifest (mr.manifest/1)
description: Entry point for the UI. Short TTL. Slice URLs are base_path + paths.<kind> with {side}, {restriction} and {tier_group} filled from the lists below.

schema.description: Schema ID and major version of this file.

version.description: Snapshot version: the UTC start time of the pipeline run that published it, as YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMSSZ. Every file of the snapshot carries the same value.

base_path.description: Folder of this snapshot's files, v=<version>/. Every path in paths is relative to it.

generated_at.description: UTC start time of the pipeline run that built the snapshot (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-09-27T04:02:20Z).

data_as_of.description: Date of the newest tournament in the data (YYYY-MM-DD). Null when there are no tournaments.

formats.description: Game formats the snapshot covers. Only Standard.

sides.description: Sides that have slices: corp and runner.

restrictions.description: Ban lists with slices, oldest first, after an all entry that combines them. Fills {restriction} in paths.

id.description: Ban list ID (a NetrunnerDB restriction ID), or all.

name.description: Display name, e.g. Standard Ban List 26.05.

date_start.description: Date the ban list took effect (YYYY-MM-DD). Null for all or when unknown.

tier_groups.description: Tournament tier groups with slices, after an all entry that combines them. Fills {tier_group} in paths.

date_start.description: Unused for tier groups; always absent.

months.description: Every month from the first to the last month with data (YYYY-MM), in order. The month indexes in trends.json point into this list.

period_months.description: Length of the current period in months (the default view): the last period_months months up to a slice's latest month with data. The previous period is the same length just before it.

thresholds.description: Settings the metrics were computed with.

min_games.description: Minimum games for a winrate to be marked ok rather than insufficient.

min_entries.description: Minimum high-coverage entries for a top-cut conversion to be marked ok.

min_splash_decks.description: Minimum decks playing a card for its splash share to be marked ok.

coverage_hc.description: Minimum decklist coverage (0-1) for a tournament with a top cut to count as high-coverage, i.e. to be used for conversion.

min_players.description: Minimum players for a tournament to be counted at all.

paths.description: File path templates relative to base_path. {side}, {restriction} and {tier_group} are filled from sides, restrictions and tier_groups.

summary.description: Current-period card metrics of a slice (mr.summary).

trends.description: Monthly additive card counts of a slice (mr.trends).

summary_cut.description: Like summary, over top-cut decks only.

trends_cut.description: Like trends, over top-cut decks only.

tournaments.description: The tournaments a ban list and tier group counts, the same for both sides (mr.tournaments).

breaker_bay.description: Breaker Bay's breakers, ice and support cards of the Standard ban list in force (mr.breaker_bay).

schemas.description: Schema ID of each file kind (e.g. summary: mr.summary/1), keyed like paths plus manifest.

attribution.description: Credit for the data sources, to show with the data.

text.description: One sentence naming where each kind of data comes from.

disclaimer.description: Notice to show with the data (a fan project, not affiliated with Null Signal Games).
